mobile_api_contract.notes: Versioned owner-scoped native client API with bounded list/detail/mutation contracts is not yet accepted.

native_identity_binding.notes: Native GoreeCloud Identity session exchange and Notes audience/owner binding are not yet accepted.

incremental_sync_and_conflicts.notes: Revision/change tokens, incremental synchronization, tombstones, retries, conflict resolution, and offline reconciliation are not yet accepted.

attachment_transfer.notes: Native attachment upload/download, integrity, bounded retry/resume, and cache semantics are not yet accepted.

local_data_protection.notes: Native local cache/storage minimization, protection, revocation, diagnostics, and recovery boundaries are not yet accepted.

privacy_shield.notes: Android-specific Privacy Shield runtime authorization and minimization acceptance are not established.

wardveil_security.notes: Android-specific Wardveil Security runtime acceptance is not established.

everkeep.notes: Android continuity/recovery behavior and clean-target restore boundaries are not accepted.

goreecloud_sync.notes: GoreeCloud Sync acceptance is distinct from ordinary API reads, local caching, and Everkeep recovery and is not established.

glaze_ui_current_stable.notes: Android must start on the then-current Stable GLAZE UI baseline and requires independent application acceptance.

representative_android_acceptance.notes: Physical-device, accessibility, input, performance, battery/network-failure, signing, rollback, and release evidence are not established.
